title: A Compass for the Landfall
author: Hazel Coldharbour
blurb: Silas Thornbury, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
